depends_on.name: probe_id
depends_on.documentation: The probe, promoted to a subject with its id preserved (device-as-subject, D2).

fields.name: offset
fields.documentation: The DC offset, a SCALAR (one document per CSV row, not a per-channel array). Volts, inferred from the writer's `offsetV` column name.

fields.name: temperature
fields.documentation: The temperature the offset was measured at. The NDI schema explicitly documents this as able to be NaN or empty, so it is neither required nor NaN-checked.
